verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services, and user-configurable autonomous background automations are not a fair axis for that kind of product. The Clerky partnership covers founder-completed incorporation workflows on a partner platform, not autonomous background automations the firm itself provides, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
